description: Graph SQL identity encoding, result serialization and NULL behavior. Both recorded scenarios returned HTTP 412 on their first observed query because Graph queries require an Enterprise or Enterprise Plus reservation; semantic results remain unverified. Remove each answer before retrying in an eligible project. Fixtures are isolated and removed after observations.

body.query:
SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE(`${project}.${dataset}.FinGraph`
MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)
RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst, e.id AS edge,
ELEMENT_ID(a) AS node_id, ELEMENT_ID(e) AS edge_id,
SOURCE_NODE_ID(e) AS source_id, DESTINATION_NODE_ID(e) AS destination_id,
LABELS(a) AS node_labels, LABELS(e) AS edge_labels)
ORDER BY edge

SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE(`${project}.${dataset}.FinGraph`
MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person)
RETURN e.id AS edge, PATH_LENGTH(p) AS length, IS_ACYCLIC(p) AS acyclic,
IS_SIMPLE(p) AS simple, IS_TRAIL(p) AS trail,
PATH_FIRST(p).id AS first_id, PATH_LAST(p).id AS last_id,
ARRAY_LENGTH(NODES(p)) AS node_count, ARRAY_LENGTH(EDGES(p)) AS edge_count)
ORDER BY edge

SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE(`${project}.${dataset}.FinGraph`
MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10
RETURN a AS node, e AS edge, p AS path, NODES(p) AS nodes, EDGES(p) AS edges)

SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE(`${project}.${dataset}.FinGraph`
MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10
RETURN LABELS(IF(FALSE, a, NULL)) AS labels,
ELEMENT_ID(IF(FALSE, a, NULL)) AS element_id,
SOURCE_NODE_ID(IF(FALSE, e, NULL)) AS source_id,
DESTINATION_NODE_ID(IF(FALSE, e, NULL)) AS destination_id,
PATH_LENGTH(IF(FALSE, p, NULL)) AS length,
IS_ACYCLIC(IF(FALSE, p, NULL)) AS acyclic,
IS_SIMPLE(IF(FALSE, p, NULL)) AS simple,
IS_TRAIL(IF(FALSE, p, NULL)) AS trail,
PATH_FIRST(IF(FALSE, p, NULL)).id AS first_id,
ARRAY_LENGTH(NODES(IF(FALSE, p, NULL))) AS nodes)
